description: This file defines the OrderAttribute class, a part of the OpenMRS project. It represents an attribute associated with an Order, extending the BaseAttribute class and implementing the Attribute interface. The class includes methods for getting and setting the associated Order, as well as its own identifier.

classes.name: OrderAttribute
classes.description: Represents an attribute for an Order, extending BaseAttribute with OrderAttributeType as the attribute type and Order as the owner.

methods.name: getOrder
methods.description: Returns the Order object that owns this attribute.

methods.name: setOrder
methods.description: Sets the owning Order of this attribute.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the identifier of this OrderAttribute.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the identifier for this OrderAttribute.

methods.name: getOrderAttributeId
methods.description: Returns the internal ID of the OrderAttribute.

methods.name: setOrderAttributeId
methods.description: Sets the internal ID of the OrderAttribute.
